Name: Porgs
Author: Ixanna
Description: [quote]﻿These are the porgs from Star Wars. I personally thought they were really cute and I made these for my game and thought I'd share. You have two forms. One with the little orange cheek patch and one that's just the brown and white. This also includes the chicks and they're also in two different colors. I tried to make sure they looked as accurate as possible so if they look a little wonky I'm sorry. Eventually I might make more animals from Star Wars. I'm working on a blue porg I saw in the concept art and a dewback replacement for the pig. If any one else has any ideas I'd love to hear them. Thanks.[/quote]

Downloads.Description: Turns chickens into porgs. Includes 2 colors and the babies which also come in 2 colors as well.
